tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsung ngag rin po che la nges par mkho ba'i chos rje brag phug pa dang bla ma dam pa'i gsung rgyun rnams phyogs gcig tu bris pa zab don bdud rtsi'i thigs pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dzwa ye/ 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa'i gsung ngag rin po che sogs yab chos dri ma med pa rnams kyi brgyud 'dzin gyi gtso bo nyams dang rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rje na bza' brag phug pa chen po dang / de'i sras kyi thu bo byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho'i sprul pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi gsung ngag lam 'bras kyi skabs kyi gsung rgyun dri ma med pa rnams/ dngos slob rnams kyis zin bris su mdzad pa'i rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab la nyan bshad sgom sgrub byed pa la shin tu mkho ba thor bur bzhugs pa rnams lhan cig tu bri bar bya'o/ /de yang thog mar na bza' brag phug pa'i gsung rgyun zin bris las 'di ltar byung ste/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams dpal ba la/ bdag gi blo'i ma bde ba'i gnas rnams su/ zhal las zhus pa yi ger brjed byang du bya'o/ /bskyed rim gyi skabs su 'di gsungs/ bla ma 'phags pa yan chad kyi phyag len la mngon rtogs rgyas 'bring gang byed kyang / rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bzhi sbyin sreg dang bcas pa rdzogs par byed cing / bskyed rim mthar phyin pa lag len shes par byas nas/ da gzod rim gyis ston gsungs/ lar mi rtag pa drag po zhig skyes/ byams snying rje bcos min zhig skyes/ lta ba lhad med cig rtogs/ bskyed rim la sems rtse gcig gnas pa zhig shin tu gal che bas las dang po nas blo ma dred par 'bad dgos gsungs/ bsgrub pa lung sbyin gyi gnad che ba/ gdan thog gcig tu dbang bzhi gcig car du nyams su len dus pho brang drug gsal 'debs pa rnams yi ger gsal la/ zhal las shes dgos pa ni/

bla ma ngo bo nyid kyi spyi gtsug na haṃ yig thig les gang ba yod pa las/ lte ba'i a thung gi mes phyi nang gi lha gsal bar byas nas/ spyi bo'i haṃ bsros pas byang sems kyi rgyun gsang gnas 'khor lo'i 'og na phyi dbyibs kyi a yod pa las yas babs kyi dga' ba bzhi rim pas babs/ yang rlung gi nus pas mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi rim pas bla ma ngo bo nyid sku'i gtsug tor mchog tu lhung lud pa las dbang rtags pho brang lnga'i gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ 'khor rnams la rang rang gi gtso bos dbur brgyan/ bla ma ngo bo nyid sku dang / phra gzugs ma sogs lha mo bzhi po ni rigs lnga'i ngo bo yin pa la rdo rje 'chang gis dbur brgyan/ lha mo bzhi po rtsa bzhi'i ngo bo las grub pa phyag mtshan kha dog rdo rje dbyings ma bzhin bsgom gsungs/ gsang gnas bde ba'i thig le'i dus su/ gsang gnas su bde ba cher skyes nas mi bzod pa'am/ nor bu 'gas pa lta bu byung na/ lag pa gnyis kyi pus mo mnan nas sked pa'i 'khrul 'khor bya/ tshangs ra sa la brdabs/ 'di nges par dgos shing lus thams cad la bde bas khyab pa yong / tsaṇḍa li'i skabs su 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa'i dus su lte ba'i phyi skor gyi yi ge dgod dus ha dang kṣa spong ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ ha ni spyi bor haṃ yig kṣa ni gsang gnas su yong bas so gsungs/ yang ro ma nas me gyen la song dus 'khor lo rnams yig 'bru rnams kyi yig 'bru khams dang bcas pa bcom zer yang mes bya sgro bcom pa lta bu ma yin par/ khams yig 'bru dang bcas pa lcags sol bas bsregs pa bzhin dmar la gsal ba me'i rang bzhin du bsam mo gsungs/ pha las thob pa'i byang sems zla ba ltar dkar ba de rkyang ma'i yas sna la brten nas smin mtshams na gnas/ ma las thob pa'i rakta ro ma'i mas sna la brten nas gsang gnas na gnas so/ /lam bsdus pa'i hūm̐ ring hūm̐ thung gi dang /

dud 'gro'i 'gyur ba bzhi'i skabs kyi dmigs pa sog sbub kyi chu 'dren pa bzhin sang sang 'drongs par bsam mo/ /tshogs bsgom pa dang / nyan chen pa'i gsung las/ 'di phan thogs nus nges la ma gtogs kyi khrid bka' med gsungs nas phal cher zur tsam las mi ston gsungs/ dbang bzhi pa'i lta ba'i skabs kyi 'bras bu 'di rnams ni/ tshogs bsgom ni byang sems dang rlung dbu mar tshud pa las 'byung gsungs te/ dbu mar rlung dang byang sems 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dus min par mi tshud/ pad can ma la ma brten par dbu ma'i rtsa kha phyed dam/ zhus pas/ dbu ma'i kha yangs su song ba tsam yin gsungs te/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang dang 'gal ba 'dra bar snang zhing rtsa dbu mar rlung dang byang sems tshud nas phyir mi ldog gsungs/ 'di la bla ma sa chen gyi gsung gis/ dbu mar rlung dang byang sems tshud par mi bzhed/ rtsa ro rkyang gnyis kyi nang du zhugs nas 'khor lo bzhi la khyab par byas pa la skyes bu'i byed pa la sogs pa'i yon tan 'char gyi/ 'di dag phyir mi ldog par bstan pa ni ma yin cing / khyad par rkyang mar zhugs pa la 'byung gsungs pa bzhin ngos 'dzin no/ /lus ngag yid rdo rje skyil krung 'cha'/ rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi ge cha'i dbyibs su 'gyur zhes pa la/ bla ma sa chen gyi gsung gis rtsa ro rkyang gnyis kyi rtse mo lte ba mar chad la gnyis gnyis su gyes nas dri chen dri chu 'phen 'dzin dang / byang sems rakta 'phen 'dzin gyi las byed la/ yi ge cha'i dbyibs su gyur pa ni dri chen dri chu 'phen 'dzin byed pa gnyis rang sar gnas la/ byang sems rakta 'dzin pa'i cha gnyis po sna rtse dbu ma'i mas snar tshud pa dang cha'i dbyibs su 'gyur gsungs/ gzhan rnams la blo rtse gtad rgyu rig pa dka' gsungs/ rtsa ro ma'i yas sna ni mgrin pa nas bzhir gyes nas rtsa sna gnyis lce la zug gnyis rna ba gnyis su re re zug ste rna ba 'on pa dang /

lce dig nas 'gro ba'ang de'i rten 'brel lo/ /rkyang ma mgrin pa nas gnyis su gyes te mig gnyis su zug cing / thig le nyams na mig la gnod pa'i gnad de yin no/ /mya ngan las 'das pa'i rtsa/ la dor ba'i skabs su/ sbyor ba mgo rtsom/ dngos gzhi longs spyod/ mjug yongs su rdzogs zhes pa ni dbu ma'i mdud pa dang po grol nas gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo phyed thig les brtan dus sbyor ba mgo rtsom pa ni/ de'i yon tan skye ba'i mgo rtsom pa'o/ /longs spyod pa ni de'i nus pa rgyas pa'o/ /mjug yongs su rdzogs pa ni de'i nus mthu thams cad rdzogs nas bogs dbyung rgyu med pa'o/ /sa mtshams de kho rang gi'o/ /nus pa dang bogs dbyung rgyu med pa gzhan thams cad kyi ni ma yin no/ /de'i dus rlung sems thig le la sogs pa'i rtags dkyil 'khor bzhi la 'char ro/ /sa mtshams la sogs pa ming gi mdud pa grol ma grol sogs ming du btags pa tsam ma gtogs don la dbu ma la mdud pas bcar te dog pa la sogs med ces kyang sa chen pa gsungs so/ /'khor ba'i rtsa la dor ba'i skabs su/ brtan pa'i 'khor lo gnyis/ goms pa'i 'khor lo bzhi/ tshigs chen bcu gnyis te bco brgyad du'ang 'dod/ gsang gnas rlung gi 'khor lo/ sum mdo me'i 'khor lo gnyis te las byed pa'i 'khor lo gnyis bsnan nas nyi shur 'dod pa'i lugs gcig kyang yod gsungs/ me dmar skya'i dmigs dpe'i dus su nyan chen pa g.yas su grangs can gyi rde'u nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ g.yon du'ang de bzhin du grangs med kyi nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste/ kha sbyar bzhi bcu zhe brgyad tshar ba dang / thun tshar bar byed de/ sa chen gyis g.yas su grangs can gyis gcig gnyis la sogs pa rlung thub tshad kyi grangs byas pa la gcig tu byas pa'i rde'u bcu gnyis/ g.yon du'ang grangs med kyis grangs mi 'dzin par rlung thub tshad du byas pa'i rde'u bcu gnyis su byed de/

rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs las byung pa dang / lugs las bzlog pa'i rten 'brel yod gsungs/ bla ma'i de lugs nyams su len/ sa chen gyi gsung gis gtum mo 'di rnams dmigs pa'i thog mar bstan na bar chad bsrung ba'i mchog tu'ang 'gyur bas legs gsungs/ thun snga ma snga ma'i steng du phyi ma phyi ma bsnon pa yin pa la/ dmigs pa 'pho thebs re la grangs can dang grangs med bcu gnyis bcu gnyis las mi bsnon gsungs/ sa chen gyi gsung gis/ 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa la yi ge ma bkod par bsgom pa'ang yod pas gang bde bya/ drug pa yar spyad ma gtogs bdun nas rlung mi bzung ba yin gsung ngo / /'pho ba'i skabs su/ chos rje pa'i zhal las/ gong du 'pho ba 'di zab par 'dug na tsha drag pos thebs na dmigs pa gzhan rnams 'chun pa dka' bas/ gong du 'pho ba 'di sla la zab pa zhig 'dug gsung ngo / /'od kyi gong bu bya ma gsar gyi sgo nga tsam byas na dmigs pa gsal gsungs/ 'od kyi sgo dgag pa dang / yi ges dgag pa ngo bo 'dra/ gang bde byas chog tshogs bsgom gsungs/ lus sbyong gi skabs su 'di gsungs/ spyir rgya gar na dzho gi lugs gsum gyi sgo nas sangs rgyas thob par 'dod de/ karṇa pa zhes bya ba 'khrul 'khor 'ba' zhig gis lus la gnad du bsnun pas sangs rgyas thob par 'dod gsungs/ dharmā pa zhes bya ba rnams lus kyi bya cha chos spyod kyis sangs rgyas thob par byed/ mu tra pa zhes bya ba sems la gnad du bsnun pas sangs rgyas thob par byed pa yin gsungs/ bla ma sa chen gyi gsung gis khrid kyi ming don ni/ spang bya rnams rim gyis spangs nas 'thob bya'i yon tan rnams gong nas gong du khrid par byed pas khrid ces so/ /'khor lo 'chams pa 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi skabs kyi dbang bzhi gar gyi lam la/ ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i rgyu rkyen tshogs shing zhugs pa tshogs lam/ ting nge 'dzin skyes pa na sbyor lam mo/

/nges shes thag chod pas 'phel 'grib med pa sgom lam/ goms pa mthar phyin pa mi slob lam mo/ /'jig rten pa'i lam du 'bras bu bzhi 'chad ces pa ni/ 'bras bu de dag ni ting nge 'dzin gyi nus pa tsam la 'bras bur btags pa'o/ /bla ma 'phags pa'i gsung gis/ grib ma mi 'byung bar bya ba'i thabs khyad par can ni/ dam tshig gi grib la nyams pa sor gzhug dbang zhu bar byas pas ni mi 'byung ba'i mchog go /grogs grib la sems can thams cad pha ma ma byas pa med cing / khyad par byang chub bsgrub pa'i grogs mchog yin pas gnas skabs su las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis nyams grib kyis gos nas mtha' med 'khyams dgos pa 'di snying re rje snyam pa'i byams snying rje yang yang bsgom zhing 'di dag 'khor ba las bskyab par bya snyam pas yi dam lhar bsgom la/ dgug gzhug lag len ltar yang yang byas pas mi 'byung ba'i mchog go /zas grib la bdud rtsi byin rlabs bzhin byas nas zos pas mi 'byung ngo / /gnas grib la bsrung 'khor dang gzhal yas khang bskyed bsdad pas grib mi 'byung ngo / /ro grib la bskyed rdzogs zab mo nyams su len pa la/ rab dur khrod la sogs par 'gro dgos par bshad pa la bdag gi der ma phyin kyang rten 'brel 'dir 'grig pa re dga' snyam pa dang / gang zag dang chos kyi bdag med pa mtshon cing / mchog gi si dhi dang nye bas shin tu bzang snyam pas rtog pa spangs pas mi 'byung gsungs/ thig le 'dzag pa bsrung ba'i skabs su/ skyes pa g.yul du bsad pa'i rus pa brdar ba byugs pas/ zhes pa la de dag la yi dam lha'i gzungs sngags gdab dgos gsungs so/ /bu mo grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa'i bkal ba'i skud pas bsrung ba ni bal nag po la phyir bkal ba byis pa'i skud pas so/ /chos 'chad pa/ lung klog pa/ gsung sgrogs la sogs gang byed kyi sngon du mngon rtogs srung 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis bsgom/

snod gzhal yas khang / bcud lhag pa'i lhar bsgom/ bar chad mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir/ slob ma rnams kyang srung 'khor gyi nang du tshud par bsgom/ de nas bzlas pa'i dus su sleb pa dang / bdag gis 'gro ba mtha' dag gi skad du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas sems can smin grol gyi lam la 'god snyam pa'i ngang nas chos bshad pas bzlas par 'gro zhing bsod nams kyi stobs bsam gyis mi khyab rje btsun chen po'i phyag len yin gsungs/ chos rje paṇḍi ta'i gsung gis ding sang gi sngags pa 'di rnams dbang dus su rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa nam gyi tshe thob dang ngos bzung dang blo rtse gtad rgyu mi 'dug pa/ la la rig pa'i dbang lnga thob pa dang thob zer/ la la dbang rdzogs nas las mi thob zer te/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa ni/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung lan gsum byed pa'i rting ma'i dus su thob pa yin gsungs pa'o/ /zhes na bza' brag phug pa'i gsung rgyun zin bris las de ltar 'byung ba yin la/ da ni dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa'i gsung bgros kyi zin bris rnams bshad par bya ste/ de yang srog rtsol la dmigs pa 'dzin dus/ srog gi rlung nang du rgyu ba la dmigs pa mgo 'dzin/ rtsol ba'i rlung phyir rgyu ba la mgo 'dzin/ rlung rngan rtags phyi ster zhes pa la srog gi rngan rtags sbyin pa ni nang du ring du gtong ba yin/ rtsol ba'i rngan rtags phyir ring du gtong ba yin/ nang thung du rgyu ba'o/ /rlung rngub pa rnams la mgos rgur bar drangs la 'drongs pa dang lus srong ba mnyam por yong ba bya'o/ /ngag 'dren pa drag po ni/ 'dren lugs zhi ba dang 'dra ba la/ hūm̐ gi bar che bar 'dren la i bas rlung shugs che ba dang skad bstun no/ /ngag 'dren pa zhi ba ni/ lus skyil krung pus mo gnyis la lag pa gnyis bkab ste/ sked pa drang por bsrangs nas kos kos ol mdud mnan te/

rlung nang du 'dren pa dang bstun nas rgyu smad stod du dril/ /ī zhes pa ring la ber dang bcas pa 'dren cing / 'drong khar dal bus mgrin pa bsrong ba dang bstun te mig gyen la hur phyung la/ rlung mi bde ba ma byung bar du rang sor 'jog go /tshangs pa'i thog ni/ rkang pa skyil krung / lag pa gnyis pus mo gnyis la dgab/ rlung ro bus/ 'og rlung gyen la 'then pa dang bstun nas rgyu smad tshigs pa la bzhar te 'gro bas rlung stod du 'then nas/ mdun du mgos sgur ba byas nas rlung sna nas dal bus rngub cing 'drongs pa dang mig gyen du blta/ dpung pa gnyis mtho bar byas/ rlung rta mchil ma gcig sgra med du mid la lte ba yan 'bur ba/ man chad tshigs pa la 'byar bar byas la rlung thub tshad bzung / mi thub pa dang steng rlung dang ro stod dus gcig tu bdag 'dzin med par btang / rlung dal bus sna nas btang dmigs pa gzhung na gsal/ yang lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gzhan yang bca' zhes pa ni/ steng rlung rnam par 'gog pa'i phyag len ni/ rkang pa skyil krung / lag pa g.yon pa'i mdzub mos sna g.yas bkag g.yas pa rdo rje khu tshur nu ma g.yon gyi thog tu bzhag mdun du cung tsam sgur bas/ rlung sna g.yon nas 'dren pa dang bstun nas lus bsrangs/ rlung kha sbyar nas ro stod g.yas su bskor ba theb re la tshangs ra bsdebs pa thengs re dang bstun nas ro stod sor ltar bsgril nas/ de lta bu lan gsum byas la lag pa g.yas pas sna g.yon bkag la/ g.yas nas rlung drag tu phyir bud pa'o/ /mdzod spu skra dkar sa bon ni/ rkang pa skyil krung lag gnyis pus mo la dgab/ yang na mnyam yang rung / lus bsrangs te lce rtse gre bar log la lce rtsa 'jibs la/ mchil ma dang por yang / bar mtha' gnyis su 'o ma dang zho bzhin 'gyur te/ dmigs pa dang yon tan/ gzhung du gsal/ bgrang pa'i mthas srungs ces dang / rkang pa skyil krung / lag gnyis khu tshur bsnol ba snying khar drag tu bsgril/

so bsgrigs/ lce rkan la sbyar/ mig steng du bgrad/ gre mo gnyis grims par phyir gdengs pa dang rlung kha sbyar ro/ /gling bzhi dbang du bsdu ba ni/ rkang pa skyil krung / lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur drag tu sgrims pa snying khar bsnol te sor mo rnams bsdams/ rkang pa'i sor mo'ang drag tu bskums lce rang gnas/ mig gyen du blta/ so bsgrigs/ mchu bgrad/ rlung kha sbyar ro/ /ha hal drag tu slong la/ lus skyil krung / lag gnyis pus mo la bkab/ rgal tshigs drang por bsrangs nas/ mgrin pa cung zhig sgur bas hā zhes pas drangs la hal ces pas shugs nang du phyung pas so/ /bum lha'i spyod pa ni/ tshang ra'i dal mo sa la btsugs rkang pa brkyangs/ ro stod cung zad bteg lag pa brkyangs te grim sha dang bcas pas snyongs/ rlung kha sbyor/ rdo rje gtun du sprul pa ni/ rdo rje skyil krung bcas nas/ khu tshur sa la btsugs te lus bar snang bteg nas sa la brdebs pas so/ /gsang gnas bde ba'i thig le ni/ rlung ci bder bzhag a long 'byed 'dzum byas te/ 'byed dus dal bus phyir 'gro tshad 'phul/ 'tshum dus nang du drag tu bskums/ dmigs pa/ yon tan gzhung du gsal/ dud 'gro'i 'gyur ba bzhi po'i glang chen hing ni/ hing zhes pa'i sgras nang du 'dren pa dang bstun nas rgyu smad tsha zhal te stod du hril yong gnad yin/ dmigs pa gsang gnas kyi thig le lte bar 'drong ba bsam mo/ /stag mo'i ngur ni/ lce yar skan la ma reg pa gre bar cung zad zug nas/ ngur zhes pa dang bstun nas rlung nang du 'dren cing lte ba tshigs pa la bzhar gyin stod du 'then/ lte ba'i thig le rnams snying khar 'drongs par bsam mo/ /gcan gzan skyugs ni/ hā zhes pas rlung nang du nar drangs la/ hag ces pas drag por 'og rlung steng du drangs/ dmigs pa snying kha'i thig le mgrin par 'drongs par bsam mo/ /wa ltar snom pa ni/ mgrin pa cung zad sgur bar byas la rlung sna nas dal bus rngub cing mgo dgyed dgyed pa gnyis dang rlung drag tu dus gcig la rngub ste/

mgo shugs phyung la ltag pa dgyed bya'o/ /dmigs pa mgrin pa'i thig le spyi gtsug tu 'drongs par bsam mo/ /bzhi char la rkang pa skyil krung lag gnyis pus mo la bkab/ rgal pa bsrangs te mgo mdun du sgur bar drangs la 'drongs khar mgrin pa cung zad sgur bar byas la de nas 'jing pa bsrangs la mig steng du bgrad/ 'di rnams gcig rting la gcig lus gnad gcig la bstud mar drangs pa'i rjes su seṅge rnam grol gyis khroms par bya'o/ /'pho ba'i hika ka zhas pa ni/ lus skyil krung / lag gnyis pus mo bkab/ rgal tshigs bsrangs/ mgrin pa sgur bar byas la rlung nang du 'dren pa dang bstun nas hig ces drag tu byas la/ tshigs pa lto bar bcar btang / ka zhes pa rlung phyir 'gro dus shugs kyis 'byung ngo / /'di sbyong dus hik nyi shu las mang du mi gzhug las la sbyor dus nyi shu rtsa gcig gis 'pho'o/ /hūm̐ ring hūm̐ thung mdun du sgur ba ni/ rkang pa gnyis skyil krung / lag gnyis pus mo la bkab/ lag pa bsnol mar byas/ rlung ro bus nas rgal tshigs bsrangs te mgrin pa sgur bas rlung sna g.yas nas ring par nar nar pa lan gsum bstud nas rgyu smad stod du 'dren pa dang bstun nas rngub pa de hūm̐ ring / phyir bud pa sangs sangs pa lan gsum ni hūm̐ thung ngo / /de bzhin g.yon dang dbus la'ang shes par bya'o/ /dmigs pa/ yon tan gzhung las gsal lo/ /lus gtun shing gi 'khor lo ltar bskor ba ni/ rkang pa skyil krung lag gnyis pus mo la bkab ste kha sbyar te/ stod smad sked pa dang gsum 'phrul chags par g.yas dang g.yon du bskor ba'o/ /rtsa dbu ma 'di la 'dod lugs mang du yod cing / la las mas sna gsang gnas su zug par 'dod/ lam 'bras pa'i lugs kyis mas sna lte ba'i 'og sor bzhi tsam du sleb par 'dod/ srog pa rtsa'i mdun na yar chos bzhi ldan du gnas nas tshangs bug nas 'thon te 'tshogs steng na mar brgyud nas smin mtshams su yas sna sleb par 'dod cing /

shi ba'i dus su 'ja' yal ba bzhin song nas mi mthong bar 'dod la/ 'ga' zhig dbu mar rlung tshud nas phyir mi ldog par 'dod de/ 'jig rten pa'i lam dang / shi ba'i dus su'ang rlung dbu mar tshud de phyir ldog la/ de dag gi dus su rlung tshud pa de ni dbu ma'i mas snar tshud pas ting nge 'dzin mchog skye ste brtan pa ni ma yin/ mdud pa dang po grol ba yan tshad rlung dang byang sems tshud pas mthong lam thob ste phyir mi ldog pa'o gsungs/ 'chi ltas kyi skabs su nam mkha'i me tog yal ba ni/ mig nam mkha' dwangs pa la mig 'bras mi 'gul bar bltas pas nam mkha' la skya long ba yong ba ni me tog go /'chi bslu'i nam mkha' zas su bza' ba'i lus gnad ni/ skyil krung chung ba zhig bcas/ pus mo la lag gnyis bkab/ kha gdangs rlung sgra med rngub pa'o/ /'pho ba'i lus gnad ni/ lag gnyis ltag par bkab/ gru mo gnyis mdun du 'phrad par bya/ ro rkyang gnyis bsdams pa'o/ /spyir rang chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs skye 'gag gnas gsum gyis stong pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad bral ba bsgom pa la bying rmugs gnyis 'byung bas de ma bsal na skal bar bsgoms kyang bogs mi 'byung bas de bsal pa'i thabs/ lus gnad ldan pas rig pa hur phyung / mig bar snang la hrig ge gang la'ang 'dzin stangs med par 'jog cing gsal cha ma 'gags par dwangs sing nge spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /des bying pa'i rkyen thams cad sel lo/ /gsal stong rig pa ngar dang ldan pa de'i ngang la sems ma bcos blod nas 'jog pa la zhi gnas mtshan nyid par 'jog gi des rgod pa'i rkyen thams cad sel lo/ /rnam rtog mi 'phro ba tsam gyis mi chog gnyid dang bsres yin mun sgom kyis lam sna zin pa la mi phan gyi steng du dud 'gror skye ba'i las bsog pa rtsod med yin gsungs/ yang lus dgon pa la sems tshong 'dus byas na/ dben khrod mal du lo dang bskal par bsdad kyang 'byung med pas phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad blos legs par spros pa bcad la/

bying rgod gnyis kyi skyon gyis ma gos pa'i ngang nas rtse gcig tu bsgoms na/ 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs pa la dka' ba med gsungs/ yang sgom chen pa 'ga' zhig rlung skyon gyis rna ba 'ur ba la gril can gyi sgrar 'dzin pa mang ste/ gril can gyi sgras phyi rol gyi sgra grags pa 'gag mi nus shing / rlung skyon gyis phyi'i sgra la gnod do/ /'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bco lnga po 'di'i steng nas lam du 'khyer shes na 'di'i khongs su ma 'dus pa'i ting nge 'dzin med gsungs/ de la lam gsum/ rten 'brel gsum/ drod gsum/ nyams gsum/ ting nge 'dzin gsum ste bco lnga po 'di nyams snang bsam gyis mi khyab pa rigs bsdus pa'o/ /sems zin pa'i rtags ni mthong snang thams cad mig g.yas kyis mthong / thos snang thams cad rna ba g.yon gyis thos so/ /gdan sogs kyi lha rnams la bzhugs tshul phyed krung dang skyil krung du 'dod pa'ang yod de/ sbas bshad du/ he ru ka bzhengs pa g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums su bzhugs par 'dod/ bdag med ma'i byin rlabs la lus dkyil dang mthun par dbang rdzas mi gtod/ spyan dar/ cod pan gtod/ sindhu ra'i 'og gi bdud rtsi 'thung / slob ma du yod kyang cho ga spyi ru byed/ bla mas rdo rjes dril bu gang dgos su dkrol/ slob ma la mi gtod 'dug bla ma 'phags pa'i gsung gis lam dus kyi dbang la mtha' brten gzhan rnams mi mdzad kyi/ gsang dbang gi lung bstan pa ni sa paṇa mdzad kyi 'dug pas de'i lugs bzhin byed gsungs so/ /nyan chen po'i gsung gis/ 'jug pa sel ba'i lam bya ba bskyed rim la sems 'dzin rung / rlung bsgom rung / lta ba skyong rung / 'jug pa sel ba'i lam du 'gro ba zhig cis kyang dgos/ rnam rtog gar 'gro btang nas dge sbyor byed pa ltar byas kyang phan gnod ci yang med gsung ngo / /zhes gsung ngag rin po che la nye bar mkho ba'i chos rje brag phug pa dang /

bla ma dam pa'i gsung rgyun rnams phyogs gcig tu bris pa zab don bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ lhar bcas 'gro ba'i 'dren pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang / rgyal ba mus pa chen po sogs kyis rjes su bzung zhing / rnal 'byor dbang phyug stobs kyi mgon pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma cung zad rmi lam du mthong ba sa skya pa theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis bris pa 'di/ zhing skyong stobs 'phrog nag pos skal ldan rnams la 'phel zhing bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsal lo/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 10 a myes zhabs/ chos rje brag phug pa dang bla ma dam pa'i lam 'bras gsung rgyun rnams phyogs gcig tu bris pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 11
